premises.text: Parking scarcity makes drivers agitated and generates circling traffic
premises.evidence_span: half of the traffic in Brooklyn is actually caused by people circling for a parking spot

premises.text: Curb Karma is a smartphone social network that finds and reserves parking spots between strangers
premises.evidence_span: Curb Karma is an app for your smartphone available for the very first time today. And with Curb Karma, you can participate in a social network for parking

premises.text: Two purchasable Karma Credits reserve a spot; the giver earns one credit and the platform keeps one
premises.evidence_span: A Karma Credit is worth $1 and available for purchase in the App Store. And so Marissa needs two Karma Credits to reserve a spot

premises.text: App workflow publishes spots, matches seekers, notifies accept/reserve, and rates the exchange
premises.evidence_span: by her third click, she has a list of spots that are available

premises.text: Messaging without personal contacts plus GPS navigation enable the physical handoff
premises.evidence_span: Marissa can use the built-in navigation feature using GPS to navigate to the spot

premises.text: Capture a small share of high-demand spot exchanges and expand to high parking-pain cities worldwide
premises.evidence_span: Our plan is to expand to cities all over the world

value.text: End parking madness by matching leavers and seekers to curb spots
value.evidence_span: end that madness and to disrupt parking

causal_links.evidence_span: finds you parking where and when you need it

notes: Singleton D3 retained: credit take-rate is an independently revisable commercial module. Demo feature list treated as one app-workflow premise (P4) per §4.1.2.
